{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''moff''' of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] was traveling with the [[Imperial Eighth Fleet]] when he received a cryptic message from an anonymous source. Deciphering the message revealed it to be from an Imperial sympathizer warning the fleet of an imminent Republic ambush. The fleet was able to change course in time to avoid the ambush.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Crack the Code}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Update 4.1. that altered the text of many Crew Skill missions to make them faction-neutral changed the moff to a high-ranking officer.
